title: Define operator access to the account
description: Write down how we reach the account to operate it: which role, who may assume it and what it may do. This is the first version of operator access for the managed service.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-11-11: AdministratorAccess on the account was copied from the management account's assignments, so two users hold it. Ryan to confirm the second user should.
